stemMarkdown: A can do a piece of work in 15 days. A and B working together finish it in 11 days. How many days would B alone take? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Together they do $\dfrac{1}{11}$ of the work per day and A alone does $\dfrac{1}{15}$, so B's daily rate is $\dfrac{1}{11} - \dfrac{1}{15} = 0.024242$. B alone needs $41.25$ days.
